title: Prologue
summary: PROLOGUE, noun pro'log. [Latin prologue; Gr. discourse.] The preface or introduction to a discourse, or performance, chiefly the discourse or poem spoken before a dramatic performance or play begins.

inlines.v: PROLOGUE, noun pro'log. [Latin prologue; Gr. discourse.] The preface or introduction to a discourse, or performance, chiefly the discourse or poem spoken before a dramatic performance or play begins. PROLOGUE, verb transitive pro'log. To introduce with a formal preface.
